parsed.g: Display the list of issues in the OpenAPITools/openapi-generator repository that have labels related to OpenAPI Generator CLI
P_t: Navigated to the OpenAPITools/openapi-generator repository at http://172.185.52.29:8023/OpenAPITools/openapi-generator
Navigated to the Issues list page for the repository
Switched to the 'All' tab to view all issues (open and closed)

Applied a label filter for 'cli' to the issues list, resulting in the URL http://172.185.52.29:8023/OpenAPITools/openapi-generator/-/issues?sort=created_date&state=all&label_name%5B%5D=cli&first_page_size=20
R_t: Wait for the issues list filtered by label 'cli' to fully load and display the results to the user
parsed.e_t: The current page is the Issues list for OpenAPITools/openapi-generator, filtered by label 'cli' with state=all. The canonical URL in the DOM is http://172.185.52.29:8023/OpenAPITools/openapi-generator/-/issues?sort=created_date&state=all&label_name%5B%5D=cli&first_page_size=20. The page structure shows the issues list container (js-issues-list-root) with the correct data attributes including rss-path and calendar-path both containing label_name%5B%5D=cli, confirming the filter is correctly applied. The issues list content is rendered via JavaScript (Vue/webpack), so the actual issue items are not visible in the static DOM but the filter parameters are correctly set.
C: The issues list is rendered client-side via JavaScript; the static DOM does not show individual issue items
The label filter must use label_name[] query parameter format, not the text-box label: syntax
The agent is not signed in, which may limit some actions but should not prevent viewing public issues

F_t.action: Typed 'OpenAPITools/openapi-generator' into global search box at step 1
F_t.cause: Global search did not directly navigate to the repository page; it returned search results including issues instead

F_t.action: Typed 'OpenAPITools/openapi-generator label:"cli"' into the issues search/filter textbox at step 3
F_t.cause: The search box appended text rather than replacing it, resulting in a duplicated malformed query that returned 0 results

F_t.action: Typed 'label:"cli"' into the issues search/filter textbox at step 7
F_t.cause: The type action with press_enter=1 caused the filter to be parsed incorrectly, resulting in label_name[]=li" (truncated/malformed) instead of label_name[]=cli, producing 0 results per DOM showing filter token '~li"'

Clicking Clear removed the malformed filter but also reset the issue count to 0 for all tabs (Open 0, Closed 0, All 0), indicating the filter was fully cleared but left the page in a no-filter state temporarily

K_t: The correct URL for issues filtered by CLI label is: http://172.185.52.29:8023/OpenAPITools/openapi-generator/-/issues?sort=created_date&state=all&label_name%5B%5D=cli&first_page_size=20
The label name for OpenAPI Generator CLI-related issues appears to be 'cli' based on the successfully applied filter in step 9
The ground-truth DOM confirms the filter label_name%5B%5D=cli is correctly set in the page's data attributes (rss-path, calendar-path)
The repository has 3,476 open issues and 402 open merge requests total
Direct URL navigation (goto action) is more reliable than using the search box for navigating to the repository
The issues list content is rendered via JavaScript (Vue components), so issue items do not appear in the static DOM
